claims.statement: A specified complete transition graph with exchange labels in the row space of all restoration constraints cannot produce nonzero exchange on a fully closed cycle.
claims.limits: A complete acquired graph, legal controls, and physically adequate state are not available. Failure of the certificate is not a realizability theorem.

claims.statement: Four reversible state-dependent binding phases produce (2/17,-2/17,0) species exchange and restore the modeled internal distribution although each held phase has zero steady flux.
claims.limits: Exclusive species/access gates and affinity controls are assumed, not measured; no physical auxiliary reset.

claims.statement: The synthetic period has TV contraction 9/16 and stationary Li-output error bound epsilon_reward+(5/7)epsilon_period_kernel.
claims.limits: Uniform model errors and sufficient physical state representation are unacquired. Preparation cycles cost time/work/lifetime.

claims.statement: Fig4b source values reach conductance ratio 0.4934752014676972 at 37.00510813138889 h with simultaneous reference 1.001347418694495.
claims.limits: Conductance, not Li/Na/Cl inventories. Conversion to KCl moles assumes constant volume and proportional conductance. No new measurement.

claims.statement: Donnan dialysis already uses sodium counterflow for lithium concentration; selective electrodialysis already reports species-resolved lithium transport.
claims.limits: Gradient regeneration, detection limits, pH consumables and lifetime are retained. No matched full-cost comparison was acquired.
